tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the reading sheet and the nav rail. The default body background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The reading sheet: policy and process pages, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, code, the search field at rest, the Note callout.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections, table rows and nav groups. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and step numbers. Meets 3:1 on paper, surface and sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on paper, surface, sunken and rail-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, labels and placeholder text on paper, surface, sunken and rail-soft.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary button fill, the highlighter behind active nav and search hits, the cover. Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: rail-soft
tokens.usage: Highlighter tint: search matches, the active nav item, a Required callout's ground. Text on it is ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: on-rail
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a rail fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: rail-deep
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or a mark: link underlines, the active step number. 4.5:1 on paper, surface, sunken and rail-soft.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Solid dark blocks on marketing pages and the cover, behind rail-colored marks. Not for UI chrome.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, offset 2px from the control. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: approved
tokens.usage: Status: Approved. As text on approved-soft, surface or paper. Sits off the red-green axis on purpose.

tokens.name: approved-soft
tokens.usage: Status badge ground for Approved.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Status: In review. As text on review-soft, surface or paper.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Status badge ground for In review.

tokens.name: overdue
tokens.usage: Status: Review overdue, and destructive actions. As text on overdue-soft, surface or paper.

tokens.name: overdue-soft
tokens.usage: Status badge ground for Review overdue.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text. Alias of ink: links read as text and are marked by a rail-deep underline, not by color.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing site hero only. One per page. Drops to h1 size below 768px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: The page title of every policy and process. 32px/36px below 768px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page. These feed the on-page contents list.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: If the request is under three days

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ask your manager at least ten working days before your first day off.
styles.usage: Running text of policies and processes. Keep lines to the measure token (68ch). 17px/28px below 768px.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Public holidays don't count against your balance.
styles.usage: Summaries under a page title, callout text, step bodies.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, table cells, form fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, nav group titles and badge text. Always uppercase (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Versions, dates, step numbers and policy IDs. Anything someone might compare down a column.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control group; label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (sm); nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter. Button horizontal padding (md). Gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section. Tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and the block it heads.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter. Space between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space above a page title; between major sections on long pages.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing site section rhythm on desktop. Halve it below 768px.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, the reading sheet, callouts, section rules. The default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, step numbers. Just enough to not look sharp.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The search field and keyboard hints only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and the search results popover. Nothing that sits in the page flow gets a shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text. Never wider.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the app shell.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Handbook nav rail on screens 1080px and wider.

tokens.name: toc-width
tokens.usage: On-page contents column on screens 1280px and wider.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and the search field. 44px on touch (below 768px).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule and border.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones. Metadata rows go from stacked to two columns.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets. Type steps up from mobile sizes; gutter becomes space-6.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Nav rail docks on the left; gutter becomes space-12.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: On-page contents column appears on the right.
